name: Sales Agreement

css: .agreement { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.45; color: #111; } .title { font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; text-align: center; text-decoration: underline; margin-top: 8px; } .sub-title { text-align: center; margin: 5px 0 16px; } h3 { font-size: 11px; margin: 14px 0 5px; border-bottom: 1px solid #333; padding-bottom: 2px; } .details, .schedule { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin: 5px 0 9px; } .details th, .details td, .schedule th, .schedule td { border: 1px solid #777; padding: 4px; vertical-align: top; } .details th, .schedule th { background: #f0f0f0; font-weight: bold; } .details th { width: 19%; } .schedule th { text-align: center; } .right { text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; } .center { text-align: center; } .terms { border: 1px solid #aaa; min-height: 28px; padding: 6px; } ol { margin: 4px 0 0; padding-left: 20px; } li { margin-bottom: 5px; text-align: justify; } .legal-note { border: 1px solid #aa8500; background: #fff9df; padding: 7px; margin-top: 14px; } .signatures { margin-top: 42px; page-break-inside: avoid; } .signatures > div { display: flex; gap: 16px; } .signatures > div > div { flex: 1; font-size: 9px; } .signature-line { border-top: 1px solid #222; margin-bottom: 4px; }
